label: desk
description: The desk is a long rectangular wooden surface with a brown finish and visible grain running along its length. Toward the rear edge sits a small white cloth, and several small items are arranged along the top, giving the desk a lived-in workspace appearance.

label: sofa#1
description: A long beige fabric sofa with multiple back cushions sits against a wall, accented by a floral-patterned square pillow on the left. The upholstery shows a small worn spot on the front-left seat cushion, distinguishing it from pristine examples of the same style.

label: sofa#2
description: This elongated sofa is upholstered in brown fabric with a low-profile rectangular silhouette and visible textured weave. A cylindrical bolster cushion sits along the seating area, creating a distinctive curved accent on the otherwise straight lines of the sofa.

label: lamp#2
description: A pink fabric lampshade with a cylindrical silhouette sits atop a slender dark metal base. The shade features a subtle vertical ribbed texture, and the base shows a matte finish with a small visible joint where the shade attaches.

label: window
description: The window is a white rectangular frame with clear glass and a simple sash. Outside the glass, a suburban lawn with a tree is visible, situating the window in a domestic living room.
